title_sq: Tek Qytet Studenti, Shitet Ambient Komercial Buze Rruge
description_sq: Ne hyrje te Qytet Studentit, ne rrugen Pjeter Budi, shitet ambient komercial buze rruges kryesore i cili ka funksionuar si Bar-Kafe. Ambjenti ndodhet ne katin zero te nje pallati 3-katesh ndertim i vitit 1988 dhe eshte i organizuar ne dy ambientje open space, nje depo dhe nje tualet. Siperfaqja totale eshte 115 m2, nga te cilat 62.5 m2 jane me certifikate, kurse 52.5 m2 jane shtese dhe ne proces legalizimi. Lokali ne pjesen e perparme ka dhe nje hapesire (verande) rreth 20 m2 ne te cilen mund te vendosen 4-5 tavolina te tjera. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet lokali eshte nje zone me levizshmeri teper te larte dhe fasada e xhamit i jep mundesi per reklamim te biznesit. Ambienti eshte i pershtatshem dhe per nje shumllojshmeri biznesesh te tjera si: Mini Market, Butik, Farmaci, Klinike Dentare etj. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In the Student City, Commercial premises for sale on the edge of the street
description_en: At the entrance to the Student City, on Pjeter Budi Street, a commercial space is for sale on the edge of the main street, which has functioned as a Bar-Cafe. The premises is located on the ground floor of a 3-storey building built in 1988 and is organized into two open space premises, a warehouse and a toilet. The total area is 115 m2, of which 62.5 m2 are certified, while 52.5 m2 are additional and in the legalization process. The bar in the front part has a space (verandah) of about 20 m2 in which 4-5 more tables can be placed. The area in which the bar is located is an area with high mobility and the glass facade gives the opportunity for business advertising. The environment is also suitable for a variety of other businesses such as: Mini Market, Boutique, Pharmacy, Dental Clinic, etc. The property has full mortgage documentation.
